scope: Targeted sources; not random sample, not all150 candidates screened

records.title: Movement Patterns and Residency of the Critically Endangered Horseshoe Crab Tachypleus tridentatus in a Semi-Enclosed Bay Determined Using Acoustic Telemetry
records.exclusion_reason: No tidal predictor, tide-by-diel interaction, or tide-stratified diel contrast is reported. Season-stratified day/night tests are not tidal conditional effects.
records.inspection_status: Full primary article, tables, figure captions and complete supplementary-material manifest inspected; bibliographic data search performed.

study_design.n_active_evidence: Results explicitly states n=18 for movement/season analysis; Table 2 has 18 nonzero rows and two zero rows (194, 4917).
study_design.diel_n_note: Likely the same 18 active individuals from surrounding text, but n is not repeated in the diel-test sentence; do not encode as independently confirmed.
study_design.primary_unit: Individual crab; total movements are repeated events within crab.
study_design.repetition: Each tagged crab contributes repeated movements and can contribute both daytime and nighttime, and multiple seasons/years. Four male–female pairs were tagged in 2007; paired movement persisted for days (up to 17), adding pair dependence.
study_design.analysis_limitation: Published diel test is Mann–Whitney U despite repeated contribution of individuals. Individual day/night covariance and individual day/night count pairs are not published.
study_design.movement_definition: Transition between inner bay, bay mouth and outside bay inferred when boundary-receiver sequential detections are interrupted for over one hour.
study_design.twilight_note: The two-hour intervals 06:00–08:00 and 18:00–20:00 are outside the defined day/night contrast.
study_design.site_and_cohort_dependency: Single bay; two overlapping calendar cohorts; no independent site replication.

nonqualifying_diel_summary.outcome: Movements per crab summed over observation period
nonqualifying_diel_summary.uncertainty_note: An exact paired-contrast SE cannot be reconstructed from marginal SDs without within-crab covariance (and an explicitly confirmed diel n). This is also an unconditional diel contrast, not a tide-conditioned result.

evidence.locator: Materials and Methods → Data analysis, first temporal-analysis paragraph
evidence.finding: Tests explicitly compare seasons and day/night; no tide term is defined. Web lines 208–209.

evidence.locator: Results → Migratory patterns and residency around the bay, first paragraph
evidence.finding: Contains day/night means, SDs, Z and P; season-specific Z/P only. Web lines 251–254.
Hourly totals pooled across entire study, without date or tide strata. Web lines 270–274.
Per-crab migration totals by habitat pair and residency; no day/night or tide breakdown. 229 total movements across 18 moving crabs verified from table.

evidence.locator: Discussion, paragraph beginning with previous spawning-rhythm studies
evidence.finding: Tidal-cycle findings are attributed to earlier Limulus papers; present-study external rhythms/environmental cues remain unresolved because short-range movements are undetected. Web lines 295–296.
Availability statement points to article/SI, but all three SI files are TIF photographs, not raw telemetry. Web lines 151, 304–321.

raw_data.availability_statement_claim: All relevant data are within the paper and supporting information.
raw_data.available: Per-crab aggregate Table 2 and illustrative/aggregate figures.
raw_data.not_found: Complete individual event/detection timestamps, local tide series, per-individual day/night cells, and tide-by-diel cross-tabulation.
raw_data.search_note: DOI plus data/dataset query returned publication records, paper mirrors and TrackdAT bibliographic metadata; no raw detection repository located in this focused search.
raw_data.needed_for_reanalysis: Individual tag IDs with dated receiver detections or derived transition times, monitoring effort, pair-bond information, and matched local tidal height/phase. Refit a model accounting for repeated crab observations; do not treat 229 movements as independent animals.

records.title: Passive Acoustic Monitoring the Diel, Lunar, Seasonal and Tidal Patterns in the Biosonar Activity of the Indo-Pacific Humpback Dolphins (Sousa chinensis) in the Pearl River Estuary, China
records.classification: Genuine omnibus tide-by-diel evidence; no recoverable compatible directional contrast with uncertainty.

omnibus_interactions.outcome: Number of click trains per 10 minutes
Number of minutes with click trains per 10 minutes
Number of minutes with buzzes per 10 minutes

records.estimand_limitation: The 12-df omnibus interaction spans five diel categories by four tidal categories. F does not identify a signed night/day contrast at fixed tide or a signed two-by-two difference in differences. No conditional day/night coefficients or covariance matrix are provided. Do not force these F values into the directional core.

figures.5: Separate marginal diel, seasonal and tidal means ± SEM, not cross-classified tide-by-diel cells.
figures.7: Nighttime subset means ± SEM by diel, lunar, season and tide. Tidal conditional means within nighttime alone cannot yield day-minus-night at a fixed tide without corresponding daytime cells and uncertainty/covariance.

sampling.site: Signal tower, planned Guishan windfarm, Pearl River Estuary, China
sampling.independent_biological_unit: Individual dolphins not identified; one station time series. Do not use bin count as independent animals.
sampling.dependence: Adjacent temporal bins, multiple detections of the same unmarked animals and encounters, shared station and temporal environment. Four outcomes are correlated measurements from the same series.
sampling.model: Four-way full-factorial diel*lunar*season*tidal ANOVA; no serial autocorrelation or random-individual correction located.
sampling.tide_definition_note: Extrema-centered windows ±1.5 hours; methods prose reverses high/low labels in one sentence, so Fig 2 should be consulted before coding raw-data reanalysis.

data_access.availability_statement: All relevant data are within the paper.
data_access.needed: Time-indexed ten-minute bin outcomes and diel/tide covariates, plus serial-dependence-aware refit or author-supplied compatible conditional coefficients and covariance.

evidence.locator: Methods → Acoustic data analysis, web lines 242–244
evidence.finding: Non-overlapping ten-minute bins and allocation of encounters across phase boundaries.
Full-factorial four-way ANOVA; no serial correlation correction specified.
Exact omnibus interaction rows and residual degrees of freedom.
Marginal mean±SEM panels and nighttime-only subset; no full tide×diel cell table.
Duplicate detections of the same animal explicitly acknowledged.
All relevant data stated to be within the paper; zero supplementary files in XML.

citation.title: Tidal and diel orchestration of behaviour and gene expression in an intertidal mollusc

records.reason: No tide x diel coefficient/SE or four-cell tide x day-night means/variances. September test concerns bout duration in one field population; no duration means, SD, CI, or bout records reported in inspected body/supplement. Do not substitute rhythm prevalence or gene-expression contrasts.

field_design.scoring: population fraction active, manually scored visible limpets between consecutive 5-minute images; not longitudinal individual identification
field_design.limpet_count_definition: maximum observed in period; changing visible denominator

candidate_contrast.source_locator: Results and Discussion / C. rota activity in the field; XML Par5; Figure 1I/J; Supplement Figure S1G and Table S1 period7
candidate_contrast.direction: night longer than day in September 2013
candidate_contrast.group_assignment: not explicitly attached to day/night in text; do not assume
candidate_contrast.tide_context: night activity continued through immersion at high tide during this seasonal modality

laboratory_caution.outcomes: Lomb-Scargle locomotion period (hours, mean +/- SD) and numbers rhythmic/arrhythmic
laboratory_caution.not_compatible_reason: Experiments use separate LD/LL/DD light regimes and timed spray; counts/periods quantify rhythmicity, not tide-conditional day-night activity. Sequential repeated trial phases and attrition also preclude naive independent-group effect estimation.

supplements_checked.MOESM2_docx: S1 plot and observation-period table; remaining material gene-rhythm tables/figures, gene validation, laboratory periodogram. No bout duration summaries. Tables embedded as images; TableS1 visually checked.
supplements_checked.MOESM3_FileS1_xlsx: tidally rhythmic transcript list; columns include PER,Phase,AMP,AMP.LO,AMP.HI. These CIs are gene rhythm amplitude, not locomotor effect.
supplements_checked.MOESM5_FileS3_xlsx: pathways and upstream regulators; no locomotor data.
supplements_checked.MovieS1: not downloaded or analyzed; caption describes June3-6 time lapse, not September day-night bout sample

data_availability.behavioral_raw_data_access: No repository accession for locomotor/bout data identified in article or supplements inspected; would need author-provided scored population time series or bout-level durations and tide/day-night labels.

correction.scope: H. Waldman Ben-Asher author indexing; no corrected behavioral results

citation.authors: Santini, Thompson, Jenkins, Chelazzi, Hartnoll, Kay, Hawkins
citation.title: Barnacle cover modifies foraging behaviour of the intertidal limpet Patella vulgata
citation.journal: Journal of the Marine Biological Association of the United Kingdom 99:1779-1786

design.setting: Field barnacle-removal experiment on vertical harbour wall, Raglan Pier, Port Erin, Isle of Man
design.tide_diel_conditions: Observed natural tide/day-night; experimentally manipulated substrate, compared two shore heights
design.repeated_sampling: 5-minute home/away signal; different individuals in each two-week recording

relevant_outputs.Figure3A: Each individual is a pair of marginal allocation proportions, ET and NT; not four tide/day-night cell values.
relevant_outputs.Figure3B: Group means +/- SE of ET and NT, plotted, no exact tabulated means/SE.
relevant_outputs.ET_definition: Time active while emerged / total active time
relevant_outputs.NT_definition: Time active at night / total active time

Table2.method: Euclidean distance;4999 permutations of residuals under reduced model

records.reason_not_extractable: Marginal tide-out and nocturnal allocation proportions do not identify the joint tide-by-night allocation or activity rates conditional on window duration. Group SEs do not supply within-individual ET/NT covariance. The statistical interaction is substratum x shore height; relabeling it tide x diel is invalid.
records.author_data_needed: Per-individual time active and time observed in each of day-emersed, night-emersed, day-immersed, night-immersed windows, ideally original 5-minute records to model repeated observations.
records.raw_data_statement: No behavioral repository accession or data availability statement identified in inspected 8-page primary PDF.
records.visual_verification: Rendered and inspected PDF page6 (printed1784), Figure3 and Table2; confirmed axes are marginal ET and NT and interaction row SU x HE.
